items.heading: San Francisco University High School
items.description: Senior-year courses: Honors English Seminar, AP Calculus BC, AP Statistics, Advanced Projects in Physics, Chinese IV Honors.

items.heading: Robotics Technician
items.description: Lead inventor on a **78-claim provisional patent**, “Zero-Trust Network for Robots and IoT,” one of two cybersecurity patents filed. It keeps a robot connected to its maker’s cloud for maps and updates but blocks remote commands, so a hacked vendor cannot hijack a fleet. Deployed, mapped and maintained autonomous cleaning robots at **7 sites**, including Apple, Cadence Design Systems and two Sutter Health hospitals. Trained 20+ custodial staff to run them.

items.heading: Intern
items.description: Designed and built the websites for Talos Management and Cardinal Robotics. Ran listening sessions with facility crews and **rewrote what the robots say out loud** based on what the crews told me.

items.heading: Research & Data Collection Volunteer
items.description: Ran biosensing collection for **125 participants** across 14 modalities (BIOPAC, BioSemi EEG) for studies on gaming and memory in dementia patients, and on nature and anxiety. Wrote the lab’s onboarding documentation.

items.heading: Math Instructor
items.description: Tutored 80+ students from pre-algebra through calculus in groups of one to four. Promoted to Lead Instructor; twice Instructor of the Month.

items.heading: San Francisco Youth Poet Laureate
items.sub: Office of the Mayor, SF Public Library, Youth Speaks, 826 Valencia
items.description: The city’s **inaugural Youth Poet Laureate**. Performed at 25+ civic events, including opening the **Super Bowl LX** press conference and UCSF’s Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month. Shared a stage with U.S. Poet Laureate Arthur Sze at the Asia Society gala. Wrote the collection *I Can Feel You Across the Seas* and taught 40+ student poetry workshops.

items.heading: Founder
items.description: Turned play-therapy research into free kits, about $15 each to build, for kids going through trauma or grief. **200+ kits** delivered to 5 Bay Area clinics and shelters. Funded by the Rosenblatt Grant and proceeds from my children’s book.

items.heading: Playhouse Initiative Lead
items.sub: Habitat for Humanity Greater San Francisco
items.description: Directed logistics and builds of **50 playhouses** across 3 counties. Recruited and led 300+ volunteers in crews of 15. Wrote a 150-page construction and safety manual.

items.heading: Founder
items.description: Built **ATLAS**, a Python system that scans prediction markets in real time and flags mispricing, such as one event priced differently on two sites. Uses NLP to match questions across platforms.

items.heading: Founder & Lead Organizer
items.description: Secured the school’s first TEDx license, led a team of 10, coached 6 speakers and hosted 100+ attendees.

items.heading: Author & Illustrator
items.description: Wrote, illustrated and published a children’s book on play around the world, drawn from exchanges with children in India, Peru, Korea and Ghana. Featured on KRON4.

items.heading: VP of Community, Class Representative & Peer Advisor
items.description: Elected four years running. Write the weekly digest for 500+ students and mentor a cohort of 12 freshmen. Co-lead the South Asian Affinity Group.

items.heading: Congressional Award Gold Medal
items.sub: 800+ hours of service, fitness and personal growth

items.heading: KQED Perspective Commentator
items.sub: Aired on Bay Area public radio
